title: The Inside Track: Hollywood for Writers & Creators
summary: 90-minute online workshop on how projects move through the entertainment industry: finding decision-makers, commercial viability, representation, pitch dynamics and why projects get rejected. Submit a logline for live feedback and join the Q&A. Led by a former TV actress with development, casting and producing experience.
costLabel: $99 (per Meetup search listing; not shown on the event page)
